comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Load test on staging with 50 concurrent multi-tenant calls looks clean; no 403 spikes.

content.text: Load test on staging with 50 concurrent multi-tenant calls looks clean; no 403 spikes.

Workspace scope middleware assumed a single tenantId per request, pulled from the JWT claim alone. Multi-tenant service accounts that act across several workspaces in one call hit 403s because the middleware overwrote the ambient scope on the first membership check.

Refactor resolveWorkspaceScope to accept an optional RequestContext with tenantIds[], actorType, and impersonationFlag. Membership resolution unions the allowed set rather than short-circuiting on the first match. Keep the single-tenant path as a thin wrapper so existing handlers stay untouched.
Complete when integration tests cover three tenants in one request, the impersonation audit log still records each workspace id, and p95 latency on the middleware stays under 4ms on staging.
